text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Such a dejected sigh doesn't suit
you.
What happened to your usual
screams?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, I was just taking a breather!
It's so hard
thinking up how to put on a
killer show!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Is that right? Come with me, then.
I've got
something I think you'll enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You brought me to a Santa
Monica
concert!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna put on a cool show, then I
gotta learn
from the best! Was that what
you had in mind?
You're awesome, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You catch on quick! Now come on, the
show's
starting! Let's go crazy!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: YEEEAH! SANTA MONICA ROCKS!

text_block_list.name: Santa Monica
text_block_list.text:
This will be our last song! So let me hear
you
screeeeam!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's this song... Heh... It sure brings
back
memories.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is this one special to you?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Right after I failed my entrance
exam, I
came across this song and found
out about Santa
Monica for the first
time.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
I was amazed by the power of
music—how easily
you can forget all
your worries by shouting along
with the
music.

text_block_list.name: Santa Monica
text_block_list.text: LOVE AND PEEEAAAACE!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Rock on! ♪ What a powerful scream.
You can
really feel all the emotions she's
pouring into it.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Emotions, huh...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pearl? Do you think my screams
have the
ability to empower people?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I like your screams. They're
energetic and
really cool.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But... not everyone can enjoy that kind
of
piercing and aggressive sound, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Either way, that's not quite the quality
you're
trying to emulate from the band
you admire, is it?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
You're right... It's been so long since I'd
actually
been to a concert. Now I realize
how much of a
poser I've been...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
I don't want my music to be just about
shouting. I
want to inspire people to stay
positive, but I lost
sight of that
somewhere along the way...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But that's okay. It doesn't matter if you
take
detours or outright stop in the
middle of your
journey.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't change the fact that you've
started
working toward your dream, of
your own volition.
You should be proud
of that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So go run after that light, now that
you've found
it again. You're the only
one who can follow the
path of your
dream.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Remember the girl with the
guitar I told
you about? She put out a
new song recently!
Here, take a listen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the earbuds Seeking the Pearl
holds out to
me and put them in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad to hear that! Everyone's sure
to love
this song!
choice_data_list: That really... tugs at the heartstrings!
That really... tugs at the heartstrings, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't listening to it just fill your heart
with the
courage to keep moving
forward, even in the face
of adversity?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Woo! I knew it! Things are about to get
busy!
choice_data_list: I think it'll resonate with so many people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I have to promote it on the academy's
PA system,
establish connections at all
the music venues...
Oh, and set up an
UmaTube channel for her!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's all I can do, though. The rest will
be up to
her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl can't help but wish the
best for
her aspiring musician friend and
is doing
everything in her power to help
her succeed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm! ♪ That's great! It seems her
passion
really came through!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It was like, whoooaa, waaaaahh,
ooooohhh!
Right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I think everyone should
hear it! I'm
going to ask them to
broadcast it through the
academy's PA
system! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is absolutely bursting
with
excitement as she skips her way to
the school
building.
